notes: Ground-truth answers are derived only from the supplied brochure.
For retrieval evaluation against PyPDFLoader metadata, convert the page number to a 0-indexed page field when appropriate.
The dataset intentionally mixes easy, medium, and hard questions across university facts, admissions, fees, internships, placements, scholarships, facilities, research, and student support.

questions.question: When was JECRC University established?
questions.ground_truth_answer: JECRC University was established in 2012.

questions.question: When was Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre (JECRC) established?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Jaipur Engineering College & Research Centre was established in 2000.

questions.question: How many alumni does the brochure say JECRC has?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure states that JECRC has more than 34,000 alumni.

questions.question: How many active students does JECRC have according to the brochure?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure states that JECRC has more than 26,000 active students on rolls.

questions.question: How many large campuses does JECRC have and what total area do they cover?
questions.ground_truth_answer: JECRC has 2 large campuses built across 2 million square feet of area.

questions.question: How many total placement offers are listed in the brochure?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure lists 2,230+ total placement offers.

questions.question: How many companies are listed in the placement statistics?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure lists 140+ companies.

questions.question: What is the average package for technical programs?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The average package for technical programs is 6.45 LPA.

questions.question: What is the highest package listed for technical programs?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The highest package listed for technical programs is 33 LPA.

questions.question: How many hours does Campus Recruitment Training (CRT) span?
questions.ground_truth_answer: CRT spans 500+ hours and is integrated across all 11 Schools.

questions.question: Is an internship mandatory across all disciplines at JECRC University, and how long is it?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Yes. The brochure states that JECRC emphasizes a mandatory four-month internship across all disciplines.

questions.question: How many recruiters are said to visit JECRC annually for internships?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure says over 100 recruiters visit annually.

questions.question: How many total successful internships are reported?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure reports 11,470 total successful internships.

questions.question: What percentage of the reported internships are paid?
questions.ground_truth_answer: 61% of the reported internships are paid.

questions.question: What monthly stipend range is shown for the internships?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The stipend range shown is ₹5,000 to ₹60,000 per month.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the JECRC Incubation Centre (JIC)?
questions.ground_truth_answer: JIC supports startups and nurtures innovation by providing mentorship, funding, technological guidance, industry connections, a structured startup policy, co-working spaces, and growth opportunities.

questions.question: How much in government grants has JIC secured according to the brochure?
questions.ground_truth_answer: JIC has secured ₹30+ crore in government grants.

questions.question: How many startups has JIC incubated?
questions.ground_truth_answer: JIC has incubated 100+ startups.

questions.question: How much funding has been disbursed to startups through JIC?
questions.ground_truth_answer: ₹8.4+ crore has been disbursed to startups.

questions.question: How many international universities does JECRC University collaborate with?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure says JECRC collaborates with 25+ international universities.

questions.question: Which language certificate course durations are offered by the Centre for Foreign Languages?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure lists certificate course durations of 2, 4, and 6 months.

questions.question: In how many countries is IAESTE active according to the brochure?
questions.ground_truth_answer: IAESTE is active in more than 100 countries.

questions.question: How many school students participated in India's Young Researcher Conference (IYRC) 2025?
questions.ground_truth_answer: IYRC 2025 brought together 250+ school students from across India.

questions.question: How many students participated in the 4th National ISRO Science Exhibition at JECRC University?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The exhibition had participation from over 12,500 students across Rajasthan.

questions.question: What does the Mpower Cell provide at JECRC University?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The Mpower Cell is an in-house counselling centre that provides free and confidential counselling services, including mental health workshops, peer support, and one-on-one counselling.

questions.question: How many physical books does the JECRC University library have?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure says the library has around 43,130 physical books.

questions.question: How many e-books are available through the JECRC University library?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure says there are around 17,277 e-books.

questions.question: How many e-journals does the JECRC University library subscribe to?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure says the library subscribes to 24,758 e-journals.

questions.question: What is the size of JECRC's new fully air-conditioned cafeteria?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The new fully air-conditioned cafeteria spans 18,000 square feet.

questions.question: What is the minimum eligibility for the BCA program?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Candidates must pass Senior Secondary (10+2) with at least 60% aggregate marks in all subjects and pass English from a recognized board.

questions.question: What is the annual fee listed for BCA in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The annual fee is ₹1,60,000.

questions.question: What is the annual fee listed for BCA Industry Specialization?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The annual fee is ₹1,70,000.

questions.question: What is the eligibility requirement for the MCA program?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Candidates must have passed BCA, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering, or an equivalent degree, with at least 60% marks in the qualifying examination.

questions.question: What is the minimum eligibility for the BBA program?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Candidates must pass 10+2 with a minimum of 60% marks in aggregate in all subjects and pass English from a recognized board.

questions.question: What is the annual fee listed for the core BBA program?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The annual fee for the core BBA program is ₹1,40,000.

questions.question: What are the mandatory and desirable requirements for the MBA program?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Candidates must have a minimum of 60% marks in a three-year bachelor's degree from a recognized university or equivalent and must qualify the GD-PI process. A qualifying CAT, MAT, or XAT score of the current session is desirable.

questions.question: What are the admission requirements for the Bachelor of Design (B.Des.)?
questions.ground_truth_answer: Candidates need a minimum of 60% aggregate marks in all subjects in 10+2 from CBSE or equivalent with a pass in English. Eligible candidates are directly invited for a personal interview and portfolio presentation; the brochure also mentions a situational test.

questions.question: What is the duration of the Integrated Law program and what are its eligibility requirements?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The Integrated Law program is 5 years. Eligibility requires at least 60% aggregate marks in 10+2, a pass in English, and successful qualification of a personal interview; preference is given to candidates with a valid current-session CLAT score.

questions.question: What is the duration and minimum eligibility for the B.Sc. in Hospitality and Hotel Management (B.Sc. in HHM)?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The B.Sc. in HHM is a 3-year program requiring a minimum of 60% marks in 10+2 from CBSE or equivalent with a pass in English.

questions.question: What is the minimum eligibility for the Ph.D. program?
questions.ground_truth_answer: A Master's degree in a related discipline with a minimum of 55% marks from a recognized university is required.

questions.question: What is the minimum duration of the Ph.D. program according to the brochure?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The minimum duration is 3 years as per UGC norms, extendable by another 3 years on a year-to-year basis subject to satisfactory progress.

questions.question: What merit scholarship is offered to UG students with 70% to 84.99% in 10+2?
questions.ground_truth_answer: A 15% tuition-fee merit scholarship is offered for 70% to 84.99% aggregate marks in 10+2 for all UG programs.

questions.question: What merit scholarship is offered to UG students with 85% or above in 10+2?
questions.ground_truth_answer: A 25% tuition-fee merit scholarship is offered for 85% and above aggregate marks in 10+2 for all UG programs.

questions.question: What scholarship is available for B.Tech students with a JEE (Mains) 2026 percentile of 90 or above?
questions.ground_truth_answer: A 25% tuition-fee merit scholarship is available for B.Tech programs for candidates with a JEE (Mains) 2026 percentile of 90 or above in the General Category.

questions.question: Which degree programs require students to bring their own laptops for lab and related work?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The brochure specifically lists B.Tech, B.Des, BVA, BCA, MCA, BBA, MBA, M.Des, and MVA. Students without laptops will not be allowed to attend lab classes and will be marked absent.

questions.question: What is the final cutoff date for admission to all courses mentioned in the brochure?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The final cutoff date is 31 August 2026, subject to possible extension under applicable UGC or other competent-authority guidelines.

questions.question: What reservation split does JECRC University state for NRI/Foreign National/PIO seats and general seats?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The stated reservation split is 15% for NRI/Foreign National/PIO seats and 85% for general seats.

questions.question: What late fee is charged when students fail to deposit fees by the due date?
questions.ground_truth_answer: A fine of ₹500 per day, including Sundays and holidays, is charged for up to 10 days.

questions.question: What is the annual bus/transportation fee listed for 2026?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The transportation fee for the bus is ₹55,000 per annum, with ₹33,000 due at admission and ₹22,000 as the second installment.

questions.question: For how many academic years are hostel facilities allotted to UG students according to the brochure?
questions.ground_truth_answer: The hostel is allotted to UG students for the first two academic years, which is four semesters.
